title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Cashout Fee Refund Settings by Plan
content:
Quick reference card — the two plan settings that govern when a Cartwise Shopper Payouts cashout fee is given back.

| Plan | Fee refunded when the cashout is returned or fails | Late-arrival refund: business days after the cashout date beyond which the fee is refunded |
|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | No | 0 (not applicable) |
| Instant Cashout | Yes | 2 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | Yes | 0 (not applicable) |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | Yes | 0 (not applicable) |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | Yes | 0 (not applicable) |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | Yes | 0 (not applicable) |

**How the second column reads.** A figure of 0 means the late-arrival refund does not apply on that plan. On Instant Cashout the figure is 2: a cashout arriving later than 2 business days after its date has its fee refunded.

**Hypothetical pair on Instant Cashout** (business days counted on the US federal weekday calendar, no holiday in the span): a cashout dated on a Monday that arrives on the Wednesday has arrived 2 business days after its date, which is not later than 2, so the late-arrival setting is not met; had it arrived on the Thursday, 3 business days after its date, it would be later than 2 and the setting would be met.
